controls.procedure: Execute an explicit brand outside KNOWN_BRANDS while a usable generic reference exists.
controls.expected: Canonical commercial identity precedes generic portion.
controls.observed: Seven Boys resolves only through verified branded evidence; the generic portion does not win.

controls.procedure: Fail commercial search for an unknown explicit brand while generic portion remains available.
controls.expected: Identity remains pending; no generic portion or weight fallback.

controls.procedure: Derive certificate scope from git diff --name-only between the immutable work_item_start_sha and the refrozen material head, with no curated path filtering.
controls.expected: The rebuilt scope equals the complete immutable work-item delta and its digest is generated from that exact normalized set.
controls.observed: The refrozen material head has 37 changed paths from the work-item start SHA; the builder input is taken directly from that exact Git compare.

rationale: Independent rejection showed that the alternate-brand test still used an allowlisted brand.
